name: Click Frames Collector
description: Local normal-mode attempt and completed-run dataset collector for Click Frames GD.

enabled.name: Collect normal-mode attempts
enabled.description: Stores data locally only. Practice and editor test mode are excluded.

sample-stride.name: Trajectory sample stride
sample-stride.description: 1 records every observed physics tick; higher values reduce file size.

max-samples.name: Maximum samples per attempt
max-samples.description: Protects mobile memory. Inputs and the result are still saved if trajectory sampling reaches this limit.
